model: TUDOR Royal 36 M2836C1A0-0101 (steel, black dial, Roman numerals, bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (36 mm case, Royal 36); heights are estimates (no side view) before the house depth scale. The black sunburst dial, gold Roman numerals, TUDOR print, date window and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it (the 3D hands cover them).

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette into the bracelet; the top is brushed and slopes down toward the bracelet

bezel.note: 48 segments of 7.5 deg: plain polished facets centred at 0, 15, 30 deg ..., ribbed facets between (5 radial ribs), phase read from the photo

hands.note: half widths include 0.1 mm over the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet: row joints and polished pieces are the positions measured in the photo (top and bottom differ because of the photo's perspective), so the front view lines up with it. No curl: the photo's foreshortening is built into the row positions.

steel_groove.note: shaded bottoms of the bezel grooves

gold.note: yellow-gold hands from the photo (sRGB about 240, 200, 110)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass. Black base colour keeps the dark dial clear
